Rewrite the paper from the start

1.say: Your conclusion says the repairs caused the fall in complaints. They did. They may have. You measured one district over one year and you have no second district to set beside it. Then how do I write it? 'These data cannot show that the repairs caused the fall, but they are consistent with it.' You lose nothing and you cannot be knocked down. It sounds weak. It sounds exact. A claim that is exactly as strong as its evidence is the strongest thing in the paper. The reviewer was hard on the method. Read her report again. She says the method is sound and the sample is too small. That is not an attack; it is a repair. She also said the writing was poor. Which is useless to you unless she says where. Mark that line and ignore it. The rest of it will make the paper better.

grammar.label: the academic hedge and the limits of a claim
grammar.form: limitations sections; 'within the constraints of'; 'these data cannot distinguish'
grammar.meaning: states in advance what the work does not establish

explanation.en: The strongest thing a paper can do is name what it cannot show. 'These data cannot distinguish between the two explanations' closes a line of attack by conceding it first, and it tells a careful reader that the rest has been thought about with the same honesty. Papers without a limitations section are read more sceptically, not less.
explanation.uz: Maqola qila oladigan eng kuchli ish — nimani ko'rsata olmasligini aytish. 'Bu ma'lumotlar ikki izohni farqlay olmaydi' — hujum yo'lini oldindan tan olib yopadi.

grammar.positive_example: These data cannot distinguish between the two explanations, and I do not claim otherwise.
grammar.negative_example: These data strongly suggest the first explanation, though more work is needed.

l1_notes.uz: Cheklovlarni oldindan aytish ingliz ilmiy an'anasida kuch belgisi; boshqa an'analarda zaiflik deb qaralishi mumkin.

grammar.label: peer review — the criticism that is meant to be used
grammar.form: the ordered critique: summary, major points, minor points, recommendation
grammar.meaning: criticises a piece of work so that its author can act on it

explanation.en: A useful review demonstrates that it has understood the work before it objects — the summary comes first for that reason. It separates what must change from what the reviewer would have done differently, and it never mistakes the second for the first. A review that is merely severe is easy; one that is usable is not.
explanation.uz: Foydali taqriz avval asarni tushunganini ko'rsatadi — shuning uchun xulosa birinchi keladi. U o'zgarishi shart bo'lgan narsani taqrizchi boshqacha qilgan bo'lardi degandan ajratadi.

grammar.positive_example: Two things must change; a third I would have done differently, and that is not an objection.
grammar.negative_example: I would have done all of this differently, and the paper should be rejected.

l1_notes.uz: Taqriz madaniyati ingliz akademik muhitida tuzilgan shaklga ega; uni o'rganish alohida ko'nikma.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Your conclusion says the repairs caused the fall in complaints.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: They may have. You measured one district over one year and you have no second district to set beside it.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: Then how do I write it?

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: 'These data cannot show that the repairs caused the fall, but they are consistent with it.' You lose nothing and you cannot be knocked down.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: It sounds exact. A claim that is exactly as strong as its evidence is the strongest thing in the paper.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: The reviewer was hard on the method.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Read her report again. She says the method is sound and the sample is too small. That is not an attack; it is a repair.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: She also said the writing was poor.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Which is useless to you unless she says where. Mark that line and ignore it. The rest of it will make the paper better.
